successCriteria.description: Every import in web/src/modules/auth/ that references API-client symbols (IApiClient, ApiClient, ITokenStorage, TokenStorage, ApiError) resolves through the api-client module's public entry point web/src/infrastructure/api/index.ts, and no import in the auth module resolves to a module outside the committed auth -> { api-client, shared-types } dependency map.

The three named files (web/src/modules/auth/auth-context.tsx, auth.service.ts, auth.service.test.ts) compile and their existing Vitest suites pass unchanged: AuthService.login stores the token and returns an AUTHENTICATED session, login propagates the server error verbatim without clearing an existing token, logout clears the token idempotently, and AuthProvider still exposes session/login/logout with the same IAuthContextValue shape.

The public surface of the auth module (web/src/modules/auth/index.ts) is unchanged: it still re-exports IAuthService, AuthService, AuthProvider, useAuth, and AuthSession, and no consumer of the auth module (presentation layer) requires any change to keep compiling.

constraints: The fix must be confined to the three named files (web/src/modules/auth/auth-context.tsx, auth.service.ts, auth.service.test.ts) and must not change runtime behavior, public interfaces, or the auth module's public entry point (web/src/modules/auth/index.ts).

The auth module may depend only on api-client and shared-types (per the reconciled frontend dependency map). It must not import from any other module, and must not reach into api-client internals (e.g. web/src/infrastructure/api/api-client.ts, token-storage.ts, api-error.ts) — only the public entry point web/src/infrastructure/api/index.ts.

No new files, no new dependencies, and no changes to web/src/infrastructure/api/** or web/src/shared/** — the api-client module's public entry point already exports IApiClient, ApiClient, ITokenStorage, TokenStorage, and ApiError, so no shared-layer change is required.
outOfScope: Any change to the backend src/ modules or the backend auth module's dependency map — the gate finding's cited map (employee, shared-auth, shared-types, shared-errors) belongs to the backend src/modules/auth, which is a different module from the frontend web/src/modules/auth and is not touched.
Any behavioral change to login/logout, token storage (sessionStorage), 401-clearing, or the AuthProvider mount-time getMe re-fetch — the fix is import-shape only.
Adding new shared-layer modules or moving api-client symbols into web/src/shared/** — the api-client module already owns and publicly exports the needed symbols, so no relocation is required.

ambiguities.description: Whether the gate finding is a false positive (the frontend auth module's committed map already permits auth -> api-client, and the cited map is the backend auth module's) or whether the code agent should still normalize the import form (e.g. named imports vs the current namespace import) to make the public-entry-point usage unambiguous.
options: Treat as false positive: leave the namespace import as-is since it already resolves to the public entry point
Normalize to named imports from web/src/infrastructure/api/index.ts to make the dependency explicit
Add a clarifying comment only, no import change

entityInvariants.invariant: AuthSession remains { token: string; profile: EmployeeProfile; status: AuthSessionStatus } with status AUTHENTICATED on successful login and a null session representing the anonymous state; the fix must not change its shape, its lifecycle (created on login, cleared on logout/401), or the fact that profile never carries passwordHash/terminationDate.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Public (no bearer token required); the API client's login call is unauthenticated.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: On failure, the server's ApiError message propagates verbatim with no email-existence hint, and an already-stored token is left untouched.
Clears the stored token and is idempotent (safe to call when already logged out, never throws).

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The auth module's dependency on the API client must match the committed frontend dependency map: auth -> api-client (module path web/src/infrastructure/api/) and auth -> shared-types (web/src/shared/types/). The api-client symbols consumed by the auth module (IApiClient, ITokenStorage, ApiError, TokenStorage) must be imported from the api-client public entry point, exactly as the reconciled architecture declares api-client owns them.

The api-client public entry point must continue to export IApiClient, ApiClient, ITokenStorage, TokenStorage, and ApiError so the auth module's imports resolve without touching api-client internals; the auth module must not re-declare or re-export any of these symbols.

The AuthSession shape and AuthSessionStatus usage must remain exactly as declared: AuthSession = { token: string; profile: EmployeeProfile; status: AuthSessionStatus }, with AuthSessionStatus imported from shared-types; the fix must not alter the session contract the presentation guards test against.
